problem_type: Independently reproduced signed-host canvas composer actions outside the interactive viewport
symptom: External Agent lands valid 9:16 image nodes, but selecting a bottom/left card hides model and generate controls outside the clipped stage.
direct_cause: Pinned node-relative composer extends below/left of the canvas stage; model/footer DOM is mounted but cannot be hit inside the viewport.
class_root: Opening a selected interactive node composer has no shared guarantee that its actions lie within the canvas interactive viewport.
affected_population: Manual and external Agent image/video nodes near stage edges
Text processing composer near clipped edges
entry_points: Generic image/video composer and text composer share ComposerAnchor
External signed WorkBuddy MCP plan landing and manual node selection
internal_only_reason: The invariant is application-owned: pinned composer DOM versus Nomi clipped stage. Installed React Flow viewport API remains unchanged.
invariants: Composer remains pinned below its node with constant screen width.
Opening an interactive composer or changing its node footprint reveals its actions inside the stage by minimum viewport translation without moving nodes or changing zoom.
Drag/pan frames and panel/inline hosts do not trigger viewport chasing.

door_reduction.why_not: Before4 direct anchor/placement doors; after7 machine-counted intent/context/helper doors. The extra typed reads route both node bodies to one host callback and do not add a viewport writer. Host measurement/animation cancellation is centralized; anchor stays pure and only delegates/cancels.

generality_proof: Image/video/text anchors delegate through one stable React context to the canvas host. Anchors retain pure pinned placement (the unchanged composerCanvasPlacement test bans measuring/rAF there); the host owns measurement and cancels the existing viewport animation lease before its direct write.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Coalesce one host-owned frame, reject active/panning/dragging or disconnected composers, measure clipped bounds, cancel the existing animation lease and write the minimum duration-zero translation.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Door map shows this body renders through ComposerAnchor; inFlow hosts are deliberately excluded.
Door map shows this body renders through ComposerAnchor; inFlow hosts are deliberately excluded.

recurrence.reason: Any node population near a stage edge can produce the same clipped controls, independently of creator or vendor.
same_class_scan: Inspected NodeGenerationComposer and TextNodeComposer host branching; replayed signed WorkBuddy stdio with three image shots.
node scripts/door-map.mjs revealComposer; read shared viewport animation owner and unchanged composer placement structural ban.

prevention.invariant: Selected canvas composer actions are revealed at opening without modifying domain node state.
prevention.failure_mode: Invalid/nonfinite geometry causes no viewport write; oversized content keeps bottom actions reachable.
prevention.strategy: Keep pinned placement immutable; make all canvas composer hosts use one event-bounded viewport reveal. The existing canvas critical/full suite executes the signed-host generation journey and both locale variants; no standalone unexecuted acceptance island.

legacy_paths.rationale: No competing placement path is introduced; existing pinned placement remains owner, while missing reveal is added at the single canvas host.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Nomi owns its clipped interactive stage and composer. Uses the already installed React Flow viewport API, with no third-party defect asserted.

migration: No stored-node migration: kind/model/position/size/prompt untouched; restored and new nodes use the same canvas host.
residual_risks: Investigation was prompted by user reports, but this contract records the independently established mechanism. Original USER-20261012 reports remain reviewed, not fixed: original project/card type is unavailable and stress long tasks remain. Do not treat this contract as certification that the original incidents are solved.
